footer.tagline: Geoprocessing, WebGIS and spatial databases for land management, environment and engineering.

Hero.description: I build map platforms, organise spatial databases and automate geoprocessing routines for municipalities, environmental consultancies and engineering projects. Alongside that, I research coastal dynamics with drones, GNSS and remote sensing.
Hero.credentials: Geographer (UFPE) · MSc in Geodetic Sciences and Geoinformation Technologies (UFPE) · PhD candidate in Geography (UFF)

Services.title: Services
Services.intro: I work across the three fronts that usually show up together in a territorial project: the database, the application that queries it and the survey that feeds it.

webgis.title: WebGIS platforms and geoportals
webgis.description: Map applications for querying, editing and publishing data. React and Mapbox GL on the interface, GeoServer and GeoNode for layer publishing, access control, thematic filters and reports for technical teams.

data.title: Spatial databases
data.description: Modelling and maintenance of PostgreSQL/PostGIS bases: bulk import, validation rules, consistency audits, cross-database sync and automation in Python and R.

field.title: Survey and remote sensing
field.description: Drone photogrammetry with GNSS support (RTK/PPK), processing in Metashape and Pix4D, orthomosaics, DTM/DSM, volume calculation and technical review of aerial survey campaigns.

Method.title: How I run a project
Method.intro: Order matters. An application built on a disorganised base becomes rework within months.

diagnosis.title: Assessment
diagnosis.description: I map which data already exists, how it is collected today and who uses each piece of information — an honest picture of what is ready and what is missing.

structure.title: Data structure
structure.description: I define the PostGIS model, validation rules and import flow, including the change history required for auditing.

application.title: Application
application.description: I build the WebGIS, dashboard or automation routine on top of that base, scoped to what the team actually uses day to day.

operation.title: Operation and handover
operation.description: I publish, document and train the team. The goal is for the client to keep operating without depending on me for routine tasks.

Portfolio.title: Projects
Portfolio.subtitle: Open research and teaching work. Systems built under contract stay in the restricted area.
Portfolio.privateIntro: Screens from live systems include client data and are not published on the open web. If you already have the password, enter it below. If not, request access on WhatsApp.

fitec.title: FITec dashboard
fitec.description: Streamlit dashboard to track field points, goal progress, network length and the survey map. Open source on GitHub.

coastal.title: Coastal research
coastal.description: Beach and dune morphodynamics with drones, GNSS and time series. MSc on Paiva Beach (UFPE) and a PhD in progress at UFF (LAGEF / H2O / LACCOST), including MADEPD and PELD-Tamandaré.

research.title: Scientific output
research.description: Papers in geomorphology, remote sensing and coastal management. Reviewer and editorial-board member of national and international journals listed on the CV.

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.description: Professor in the Geoprocessing specialization at UFABC. Previously taught cartography, climatology and geotechnologies at UPE, plus UAV photogrammetry courses.

webgis_municipal.title: Municipal WebGIS
webgis_municipal.description: Geoportal with orthomosaics, cadastral data and multilayer maps. Vector editing, geolocated search and executive reports.

webgis_devgis.title: Corporate geoportal
webgis_devgis.description: Geospatial hub with corporate layers, collaborative editing and publishing for partner agencies.

webgis_audit.title: Aerial survey audit
webgis_audit.description: Environment to compare campaigns, overlay orthomosaics and DTMs and record technical reviews.

webgis_epi.title: Epidemiological surveillance
webgis_epi.description: Municipal platform with traps, case records, heatmaps and threshold alerts.

spatial_db.title: Spatial database management
spatial_db.description: Activity and city-block control, bulk import, auditing and inconsistency reporting.

aero.title: Photogrammetry
aero.description: Drone flights with GNSS processed in Metashape: orthomosaics, DTM/DSM, volumes and CAD/BIM integration.
